warnings: op1 direct read (house 11). Septic tank (ถังบำบัดน้ำเสีย) sits north of row A near grid 1-2 — roughly the same area as the two unresolved C0/F1 footings flagged since S-02/S-03. Septic tanks are normally buried and don't need column footings, so this is likely NOT the explanation (a buried tank has no need for a 0.80x0.80 spread footing or a 1-pile foundation) — but flagged as a plausible proximity coincidence for a human to check against the actual site layout, since the exact tank footprint/support method isn't detailed on this sheet.

Water tank + booster pump cluster sits west of grid 1 near row A-B — also outside the main structural grid, on the same side as the ramp (A-13/A-14) — this equipment likely sits on its own small slab-on-grade, not requiring the isolated C1-type footings either.

3 storm drain manholes placed along row A at grid 1/2/3 — outside the building envelope to the north, consistent overall with utility/equipment being clustered on the north and west sides of the house.
